description:
Mixed scoped licensing: MIT for explicitly mapped original Python code/tests; CC BY 4.0 for explicitly mapped original non-text numerical outputs, IDs, configurations, provenance and documentation. LICENSE and manifests/license_scope.csv define scope. Third-party inputs retain their own terms.

Updated research software with original frozen experiments and separately labelled post hoc summaries, including rc.2 descriptive additions and current figures. Supports reporting reconstruction and saved-membership checks. Complete masked scalar and focal-neighbor records, raw text, embeddings and weights are excluded. Full fresh raw-to-encoder reproduction remains incomplete. No article manuscript/source or private audit history is included.
